scope: Native owned-sidecar startup and fail-closed bootstrap readiness. Not portable packaging or authenticated native session acceptance.
implemented: Retain owned sidecar handle until shutdown; stop process group on window close, app quit, failed readiness/navigation and rejected late/duplicate spawn. Drain child output without displaying raw errors.
Use native application data/workspace directory and explicit --dir argument instead of implicit working directory. Reserve loopback port with no fallback to a fixed unrelated service.

Wait at most 20 seconds for 200 JSON desktop bootstrap matching canonical workspace with bounded CSRF-token shape; no proxy/redirects, one-second request timeout and 256 KiB body limit. Check child ownership before navigation.
Bundle a small local startup/error view; navigate to full existing server UI only after verified response shape. No UI/backend rewrite or new server API.

rust.scope: Ownership, close-before-spawn, duplicate spawn, terminated leader cleanup, wrong bootstrap shape and exited-child guards.

validation.actual_http: Rust probe accepts actual disposable Studio bootstrap and rejects wrong workspace. Four Postman failure variants reject redirects, HTML, oversized responses and team mode.

native_build.scope: Development executable builds; no native window or clean installer executed.

browser.scope: Local startup/error assets previewed in browser, not a native installed webview.

claims.scope: Recorded-claim consistency only; this command does not run acceptance tests or certify runtime behavior.

migration: Native default workspace is now the application data directory/workspace child. Existing workspaces are not moved, deleted or imported automatically. Existing Python/CLI storage formats and server/bootstrap request formats stay unchanged. Native workspace chooser/locking integration remains pending.
remaining: Authenticated native backend identity and session handshake; shape matching alone is not authentication.
Native/CLI cross-process workspace ownership and actual native-window close/quit/restart drills.
Replace absolute build-machine Python wrappers with a bundled portable runtime containing server UI/assets and dependencies.
Clean macOS/Linux/Windows installed builds, signing, update and permissions acceptance.
